title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Interior Occurrence Scope for Recalls and Continued Failures
content:
# Interior Occurrence Scope for Recalls and Continued Failures

Claims desk adjudication note, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, interior supply and drain lines.

## Rule

The interior occurrence benefit left open is worked out over the interior occurrence scope. Interior occurrence scope: for a recall reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line, the amounts already authorized, net of reversals, on the request of that completed repair are deducted from the interior plumbing occurrence cap together with those on the service request; for a new failure reported no more than the interior continuation days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line, the amounts already authorized, net of reversals, on that temporary-repair request are deducted together with those on the service request; for every other request only the amounts on the service request are deducted.

## Figures the rule turns on

- **Repair guarantee days:** 180 calendar days on every Utility Line Protection Plan, including the two plans that cover interior lines (Interior Plumbing and Drainage, Total Home Lines).
- **Interior continuation days:** 14 calendar days.

## Decision table

| Service request | Net amounts deducted from the interior plumbing occurrence cap |
|---|---|
| recall reported on or before day 180 after the most recent completed repair on the same line | those on the request of that completed repair, together with those on the service request |
| new failure reported on or before day 14 after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line | those on that temporary-repair request, together with those on the service request |
| any other request | those on the service request only |

## Boundary cases

- Recall reported on day 180 after completion: the completed repair's request is included. On day 181: only the service request's own amounts.
- New failure reported on day 14 after the temporary repair was authorized on another request: that request is included. On day 15: only the service request's own amounts.

## Hypothetical example

Interior plumbing occurrence cap $3000.00 (Total Home Lines Plan figure); a recall on day 40 after completion; $1900.00 net on the completed repair's request and $500.00 net on the recall: $2400.00 is deducted, leaving $600.00 open.
